title: Arrest model: lateral and forward load cases
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. Design cases include ±2 g lateral and 2 g forward (ride-acceleration-data.md), but the model only handles vertical ejection. Depends on: ridebelt-model-002 (do those first or use their outputs if merged). Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Extend the model to lateral (Gy) and forward (Gx) pulses with tether geometry in 3D, reporting per-tether tension and belt excursion.
acceptanceCriteria: Tether geometry documented with a diagram
